said.meaning: keep the K asymmetric (distinctive); try carrying its asymmetry over to other letters

low: the Regular 16 with its middles at 38 (the height where the arm of the K leaves its stem) instead of 50: the middle bar of E, F, H; the spur of G; the meeting of the arms of Y (wider Y); the waist of S, B, 8, 3, 5, 6, 9, 2 (upper bowl larger, lower smaller, the lower bowl's corner cuts smaller since a cut cannot be taller than half its bowl); P, R, A, 4, M are low already; K unchanged
boldNote: the Bold has heavier bars, so with the same rule its waist could only go down to about 44
